entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary:
Rehette Stoltz (Mayor of Gisborne District Council and President of LGNZ), Rāniera Proctor (Chair, Te Taumata Māori and Sport NZ Board member), Julie Paterson MNZM (CEO, Tennis NZ), Kelly Shanks (CEO, Sport Manawatū), Heemi McDonald (CEO, Physical Education New Zealand). Facilitated by Jenny-May Clarkson.

How well are we really working together? This conversation looks at what’s helping, what’s holding us back and where we can work differently to make a bigger difference for communities.
